7.description: [A52] Fixed an issue where the Piercing Shots talent could prevent Pistol Shot from generating combo points.

1.description: [Elune] [Pending Restart] Storm Surge time window to trigger its damage is now visible on target.

[Pending Restart][Elune] Changed the proc requirement of Savage Defense from physical critical strikes while in bear form, to critical strikes with melee attacks. This is in line with how Savage Defense functioned on season release.
Fixed a bug where Adventure Mode aggro mechanics could trigger creature's Lightning Shields, resulting in a very shocking death.
Fixed a bug where Frost Bomb could consume Winter's Mantle.
Fixed a tooltip bug where Gathering Will did not indicate Fire Blast could generate stacks. Both Fireball and Fire Blast casts can grant new stacks.
Fixed a tooltip bug where Winter's Mantle did not indicate Ice Lance could generate stacks. Both Frostbolt and Ice Lance casts can grant new stacks.
Fixed an issue where Blink spells could sometimes not share an 8 second cooldown.
[Pending Restart][Elune] Fixed a bug where Unbounded Spell Slinger had higher scaling than intended.

[Pending Restart][Elune] Fixed a bug where Spell Slinger and Unbounded Spell Slinger could trigger from effects that would not consume your clearcasting buff. Both of these talents now have 2 seconds internal cooldown.

5.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed an issue where some abilities that were empowered by Zandalarian Hero Charm did not consume stacks.
[Pending Restart][Elune] Mythical Protector, the absorb shield proc on (6) Set of healing Classic Dungeon sets now has a 20% spell power scaling.
[Pending Restart][Elune] Reduced internal cooldown on (4) Set of damage dealer Classic Dungeon sets by 25%.
[Pending Restart][Elune] Increased scaling on (4) Set of damage dealer Classic Dungeon sets by 20%.
[Pending Restart][Elune] (6) Set on damage dealer Classic Dungeon sets now stacks up to 7. Up from 5 stacks.
[Elune] [Pending restart] Updated Stamina on Classic Dungeon set items to be more in line with raid item stats.

1.description: [Pending Restart][Elune]Fixed a bug where Fuego and Unleashed Fuego would not consume Combustion despite benefiting from it.
[Pending Restart][Elune]Fixed a bug where Fuego would stack up Winter's Mantle instead of removing it.
[Pending Restart][Elune] Fixed a bug where Arctis and Fuego could have their cooldowns reset by unintended interractions.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where the global cooldown of Bloodthirst would sometimes stay at 1.5 sec even when it was lowered via buffs.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug where Battle Charge did not share cooldown with Charge.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Battle Charge was missing its PvP Mod. The PvP mod is 0.7.
[Area 52] Execute now deals 10% less damage versus players.
Corrected a tooltip on Arcane Clearcasting talent to correctly state that the proc happens on spell casts, not damaging hits.
Corrected a tooltip of Elemental Focus to correctly mention that it reduces resource cost by 50%, not only mana cost.
[Elune] Fixed a bug enabling Hurricane Strike to trigger Rampant Tornado without knowing the talent.
Fixed an issue where Recovering Prayer was not lowering the cooldown of Prayer of Preservation. (pending restart)

0.description: Shadow Kindling is now a buff applied to the player. This will allow this talent to be used in faster paced content like Manastorm and Mythic+.
Burst of Flames is now a buff applied to the player. This will allow this talent to be used in faster paced content like Manastorm and Mythic+.
Fixed a bug where Unleashed Fuego could hit targets before Fuego, this circumvented consuming pyroblast procs allowing it to gain twice the benefit from modifiers.
Fixed a bug where Fireblast was proccing Gathering Will.

[Pending Restart][Mythic Dungeons & Manastorm][Uldaman] Fixed an issue where the Fireball cast by Geomancers did not have correct level scaling.

[Pending Restart][Mythic Dungeons & Manastorm][RFK] Amnennar the Coldbringer - Fixed an issue where the Frost Nova was scaling from level 20 instead of 60. This has reduced the base damage in Mythic by ~70%
